{{Top}}
'''Toydarian''' was the native language of the [[Toydarian/Legends|Toydarian]] species from [[Toydaria/Legends|Toydaria]].<ref name="UAA">''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]''</ref>

Most Toydarians were fluent in both Toydarian language and [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]], although they were only literate in their own language. However, they preferred to converse in Toydarian. Many Toydarians were fluent in [[Huttese/Legends|Huttese]] instead of Basic, as the species had a long commercial history with the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]].<ref name="UAA" />
